value.failure_condition: When an MCP tool completion contains a failed payload with a long error string, the Adapter formats `success=false; error={error}` without applying bounded_text, so ToolCompleted.output can exceed the 64 KiB UTF-8 body limit.
value.violated_invariant: Preserve the original MCP error text while applying the same 64 KiB UTF-8 truncation boundary used for other tool output paths.

value.failure_condition: projectValue recursively drops every key named requestId, diagnostic, sourcePath and other metadata-like names, including keys inside genuine tool output. A product item with toolOutput {requestId:event-request-42,diagnostic:compiler diagnostic,sourcePath:src/main.rs} is emitted as toolOutput {}.
value.violated_invariant: Separate internal collection metadata from event payload by origin or schema, and preserve event/tool content keys and values in the authenticated history DTO.

value.failure_condition: INLINE_IMAGE_DATA_URL matches only data:image/<type>;base64, so valid data:image/png;charset=utf-8;base64,AAAA and data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%3E remain in the product item payload instead of being omitted.
value.violated_invariant: Exclude supported image data URL forms from item and detail payloads, mark omitted media partial, and keep history envelopes bounded.
